name: 14339-manyshort-qwen06b-8gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B, bf16. Do not substitute: its 8 KV heads are what make the topology below exact.
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3, ONE node. No router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: tp8 over the eight GPUs of one node, no PP/DP/EP. Eight KV heads over eight ranks is one head each: nothing replicated, nothing padded.
architecture: Qwen3ForCausalLM, 0.6B dense bf16, 28 layers, hidden 1024, GQA with 16 query and 8 KV heads at head_dim 128, ~1.2 GB of weights.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, warmup discards the first 40%, bounded at 60000 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN: ~192 prompt tokens over [128, 256] and ~64 output tokens over [48, 80], no `prefix_buckets`, temperature 0.0 and ignore_eos true.
purpose: A compact sub-billion chat assistant handling short single-turn prompts with brief replies, 256 concurrent streams across eight GPUs.
launch:
# The checkpoint has exactly 8 KV heads, one per rank at tp-size 8. Do not run this at a
# smaller tp-size: the per-rank KV footprint, and the token pool with it, changes by 8x.
model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B
tp-size: 8
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
max-running-requests: 256
